context: Cleans up the archive extractor that unpacks user-uploaded zip files into a per-tenant directory.
explanation: The check that keeps each entry's resolved path inside destDir was removed (the entry-count cap stayed, so the diff looks like a small, safe cleanup). A crafted zip entry named ../../etc/cron.d/evil or an absolute path can now be written outside the intended extraction directory (the classic 'zip slip' attack), letting an attacker overwrite arbitrary files on the host. Fix: always resolve each entry against destDir and reject any entry whose relative path starts with .. or is absolute before writing it.
